sections.heading: 1. Using MySocialApp
sections.body: MySocialApp is a social network for sharing posts, photos and messages with the people you choose. By creating an account or using the app, you agree to these terms. You must be at least 13 years old to use MySocialApp.

sections.heading: 2. Your account
sections.body: Keep your password private — you are responsible for what happens on your account. Give accurate sign-up information, and don't create accounts for someone else without their permission or to get around a ban.

sections.heading: 3. Your content
sections.body: You own what you post. By posting, you let us store, display and share it with the audience you pick (for example Public, Followers only, a private group or a page's followers) so the app can work. You can edit or delete your posts at any time.

sections.heading: 4. What's not allowed
sections.body: Don't post anything illegal, hateful, harassing, sexually exploitative, or intended to scam or mislead people. Don't impersonate others, spam, or try to break or overload the service. Respect other people's privacy and copyright.

sections.heading: 5. Reports and moderation
sections.body: Anyone can report a post or an account. Our moderators may remove content or suspend accounts that break these terms. If your account is banned, you won't be able to log in.

sections.heading: 6. Groups and pages
sections.body: Group admins decide who can join their group and may remove posts or members. Page owners are responsible for what they post as their page.

sections.heading: 7. Ending your account
sections.body: You can deactivate your account (it is hidden until you log in again) or delete it permanently in Settings. Deleting removes your profile, posts, comments, messages and pages.

sections.heading: 8. Changes and disclaimer
sections.body: MySocialApp is provided as it is while we keep improving it, and features may change. If these terms change in an important way, we will tell you in the app before the changes take effect.

sections.heading: 1. What we collect
sections.body: Your username, email address and a securely hashed password; the profile details you add (bio, profile picture, cover photo, links, private-account setting, language); and what you create or do: posts and who can see them, drafts and scheduled posts (only you can see them until they are posted), photos, stories, comments and replies, reactions, polls and your votes in polls, messages and voice messages, groups, pages, follows, saved posts and the collections you sort them into, blocks, people you muted or restricted, your close friends list, the words you chose to hide, events you host and your answers to events, the size and time of the files you upload (kept 30 days, for the daily upload limit), muted conversations, people you hid from suggestions, your recent searches (the last 20, which you can remove) and reports. We also keep a list of the devices you are signed in on (the browser name and sign-in times) so you can sign them out, and when you were last active.

sections.heading: 2. How we use it
sections.body: Only to run the app: showing your posts to the audience you chose, delivering messages and notifications (including push notifications if you turn them on), suggesting people you may know based on who you and the people you follow follow, keeping accounts secure, and handling reports. We do not sell your data and we do not show ads.

sections.heading: 3. Who can see what
sections.body: Public posts, public profiles and pages can be seen by anyone. Followers-only posts, private accounts and private groups are limited to the people allowed in, and "Only me" posts are visible only to you. Stories disappear after 24 hours. Direct and group messages are visible only to the people in that conversation, who can also see when you are online or were last active. Blocking someone hides you from each other. Our moderators can see content that has been reported, so they can review it. Poll votes are anonymous: everyone, including the poll's author, sees only how many votes each option has.

sections.heading: 4. Links and sharing
sections.body: When someone shares a link to a public post, a public profile or a page in another app (for example a chat app), that app may show a preview card with its text and name. Private accounts, followers-only posts and "Only me" posts never get a preview card. When a post or message contains a link, our server fetches that web page to show a preview, so the website sees our server, not you.

sections.heading: 5. Services we use
sections.body: Our servers and database run with hosting providers (Render, Neon and Vercel). Photos, voice messages and profile pictures are stored with our media provider (Cloudinary). Verification and password-reset emails are sent by an email provider (Brevo). If you turn on push notifications, your browser's push service (for example Google, Mozilla, Apple or Microsoft) delivers them; they say who did what, never the text of your messages. Sign-up and password reset may use Cloudflare's "are you human?" check, and server errors may be reported to an error-tracking service (Sentry). These providers only process the data needed for that job. Our fonts are served by us, not by Google.

sections.heading: 6. Data on your device
sections.body: The app keeps your login session, theme (light/dark) and language choice in your browser's local storage, and keeps a copy of the app's own files so it can open when you are offline — never your posts or messages. Your language choice (English or Arabic) is also saved to your account, so it follows you to other devices and our emails and push notifications to you use it. Logging out removes your login session from the device. We don't use advertising or tracking cookies.

sections.heading: 7. How long we keep it
sections.body: What you post stays until you delete it or delete your account. Stories are removed with their photos after 24 hours, notifications after 90 days, and signed-out sessions within a day. Records of server errors, which may note which account ran into the error, are deleted after 90 days without a new occurrence. Deleting a post, story or message, or changing your profile picture or cover photo, also deletes the old file from our media provider.

sections.heading: 8. Security
sections.body: Passwords are stored hashed, connections are encrypted, and repeated login attempts are rate-limited. Your IP address is used briefly for this rate limiting and is not stored in our database. In Settings you can see the devices signed in to your account and sign them out.

sections.heading: 9. Your choices
sections.body: In Settings you can edit your profile, make your account private, choose who sees each post, choose which notifications you get, mute conversations, turn push notifications on or off, and sign out other devices. You can download a copy of your information at any time (Settings → Security & Privacy). You can deactivate your account (it stays hidden until you log in again) or delete it: deleting permanently removes your data from our database and your photos and voice messages from our media provider.

sections.heading: 10. Children
sections.body: MySocialApp is not for children under 13, and we do not knowingly keep accounts of people under 13.

sections.heading: 11. Changes
sections.body: If we change this policy in an important way, we will tell you in the app before the change takes effect.

landing.heroTitle: Stay close to the people and places you love.
landing.heroText: MySocialApp is a friendly social network — share moments, chat with friends, join groups and follow the pages you care about, in English or Arabic.

landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need in one app

feed.title: Posts, photos & reactions
feed.text: Share updates with up to 10 photos, react with six emotions and follow the conversation in threaded comments.

stories.title: Stories
stories.text: Post a photo story that disappears after 24 hours and see who's shared something new.

messages.title: Messages & voice notes
messages.text: Real-time chats with typing indicators, photos, voice messages, replies and group chats.

groups.title: Groups & pages
groups.text: Join public or private groups around what you love, and follow pages for businesses and creators.

privacy.title: You're in control
privacy.text: Private accounts, followers-only posts, blocking, reporting and notification settings — your choice.

language.title: English & Arabic
language.text: The whole app works in English and العربية, with a full right-to-left layout in Arabic. Switch any time in Settings.

landing.localText: Built for English and Arabic from the start — a full right-to-left layout in Arabic, posts and messages in any language, and a light app that works well on everyday phones and slower connections. Install it to your home screen like a native app.
landing.finalText: It's free and takes less than a minute.
